// Package container implements an ordered map with generics.
package container

import (
	"cmp"
	"fmt"
	str "strings"
	_ "embed"
)

// Number is a constraint with a type set.
type Number interface {
	~int | ~int64 | ~float64
}

type Pair[K comparable, V any] struct {
	Key   K `json:"key"`
	Value V `json:"value,omitempty"`
}

// OrderedMap keeps its keys sorted.
type OrderedMap[K cmp.Ordered, V any] struct {
	pairs []Pair[K, V]
	index map[K]int
	*fmt.Stringer
	sync.Mutex
}

type (
	Visitor[K any] func(key K) bool
	Alias          = OrderedMap[string, int]
	Matrix         [3][3]float64
)

func New[K cmp.Ordered, V any](capacity int) *OrderedMap[K, V] {
	return &OrderedMap[K, V]{index: make(map[K]int, capacity)}
}

func (m *OrderedMap[K, V]) Set(key K, value V) (old V, ok bool) {
	if i, found := m.index[key]; found {
		old, m.pairs[i].Value = m.pairs[i].Value, value
		return old, true
	}
	m.pairs = append(m.pairs, Pair[K, V]{key, value})
	m.index[key] = len(m.pairs) - 1
	return
}

func (m *OrderedMap[K, V]) Each(visit Visitor[K], rest ...func(V) error) {
	for _, p := range m.pairs[:len(m.pairs):cap(m.pairs)] {
		if !visit(p.Key) {
			break
		}
	}
}

func Sum[T Number](xs ...T) (total T) {
	for _, x := range xs {
		total += x
	}
	return total
}

func (Matrix) String() string {
	return str.Repeat("=", 1<<2+3*4-5) + fmt.Sprint(0x1p-2, 1_000, 0o17, 0b1010, 1e3i, 'x', '\n', `raw`)
}
